transport: Keep republican-history sites and Qinhuai old-city walking in one central cluster when possible.
Use metro for cross-city movement and avoid stacking too many hill or mausoleum climbs on one day.
Night views around Qinhuai work best as the final anchor of the day.
bad_weather_fallbacks: Swap lake walks and mausoleum-heavy outdoor plans for museums, memorial halls, or malls.
Use major museums and indoor heritage venues as weather-safe anchors.

leisure.pace_note: Nanjing works best when you pair one major history anchor with one atmospheric walking district.

family.pace_note: Use one marquee attraction and one nearby flexible backup.

food.pace_note: Keep food planning close to the Qinhuai old-city cluster to minimize transfers.

suggested_queries: Memorial Hall of the Victims in Nanjing Massacre
theme.pace_note: Build around one strong historical narrative instead of mixing too many eras in one day.

suggestions: Good day for old-city walking and lake-adjacent highlights.
